message.creaturestudio.unknown_creature: That creature no longer exists in this world.
message.creaturestudio.too_big: The creature is too big to send.
message.creaturestudio.invalid: The creature data could not be read.
message.creaturestudio.no_permission: You are not allowed to modify "%s".
message.creaturestudio.too_many: This world reached the limit of %s creatures.
message.creaturestudio.need_egg: In survival you need 1 chicken egg to make a creature egg.
message.creaturestudio.need_creative: Direct summoning only works in creative or as an operator.
gui.creaturestudio.library.title: Creature Studio
gui.creaturestudio.library.delete_messag: "%s" will be deleted and all of its creatures will vanish from the world. This cannot be undone.
gui.creaturestudio.library.empty: There are no creatures in this world yet. Press "+ New creature" to create the first one.
gui.creaturestudio.library.no_selection: Select a creature from the list.
gui.creaturestudio.library.hint: Drag to rotate · Wheel: zoom · Double click: edit
gui.creaturestudio.import.title: Import creature
gui.creaturestudio.import.empty: No files yet. Export a creature or copy .json files shared by other players here.
gui.creaturestudio.import.failed: %s is not a valid creature file.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.title: Creature editor
gui.creaturestudio.editor.name: Creature name
gui.creaturestudio.editor.no_parts: No parts. Press "+ Cube" to add the first one.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.part.add_toolt: Adds a cube on top of the selected part (as its child)
gui.creaturestudio.editor.part.duplicate: Copies the part and its children (Ctrl+D)
gui.creaturestudio.editor.part.delete_to: Deletes the part (Delete key). Its children move to its parent.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.part.mirror_to: Creates a mirrored copy on the other side (great for eyes, legs and wings)
gui.creaturestudio.editor.part.center_to: Centers the model and puts it on the ground
gui.creaturestudio.editor.field.name: Name
gui.creaturestudio.editor.field.parent_t: The part moves and rotates together with the part it is attached to (e.g. an eye attached to the head).
gui.creaturestudio.editor.field.stretch: Stretch the texture on each face
gui.creaturestudio.editor.hint.fields: Click a field and use the mouse wheel or the ↑↓ keys (Shift: fine · Ctrl: ×5). With no field active, the arrow keys and PgUp/PgDn move the part. The creature's front faces -Z.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.hint.look: The texture is tinted with the color: use white to see its original colors. In the last field you can type any block texture, e.g. minecraft:block/stone.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.hint.anim: Animations rotate the part around its pivot (Shape tab) and the parts attached to it follow. Use A and B on opposite limbs so they alternate.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.hint.stats: For reference: a zombie has 20 health, 3 damage and 0.23 speed. Scale multiplies the model size.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.hint.ai: "Tempted by item": the creature follows you while you hold that item (e.g. minecraft:wheat). If you pick a ranged attack, it shoots instead of hitting.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.hint.spawn: Comma separated biomes, e.g. minecraft:plains, #minecraft:is_forest. The chance is rolled every 5 seconds per player.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.preview.help: Drag: rotate · Right drag: pan · Wheel: zoom · Click a part: select it
gui.creaturestudio.editor.preview.help_b: Drag: rotate · Right drag: pan · Wheel: zoom
gui.creaturestudio.editor.too_big: Model too big: remove some parts.
gui.creaturestudio.tab.template.desc: Start from a ready-made model, then change it as you like in the other tabs.
gui.creaturestudio.tab.parts.desc: The cubes that make up the body. Add, copy, mirror, delete and attach parts.
gui.creaturestudio.tab.shape.desc: Position, size and rotation of the selected part. Measured in pixels: 16 = 1 block.
gui.creaturestudio.tab.paint.desc: Pick the color and texture of the part.
gui.creaturestudio.tab.animate.desc: Choose how the part moves when the creature walks, looks around or attacks.
gui.creaturestudio.tab.stats.desc: Health, damage, speed and size of the creature in the world.
gui.creaturestudio.tab.behavior.desc: Whether it is friendly or attacks, walks or flies, what it shoots and which sounds it makes.
gui.creaturestudio.tab.spawn.desc: Where it spawns on its own, what it drops and the colors of its egg.
gui.creaturestudio.templates.warning: Choosing a template replaces the current model and settings. Changed your mind? Press Ctrl+Z.
gui.creaturestudio.templates.hint: Hover over a template to see it in the 3D view, and click to use it.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.no_parts_here: This model has no parts yet. Add them in the Parts tab.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.piece_pick: Pick the part from a list. You can also click it in the 3D view.
gui.creaturestudio.editor.pivot.center_t: Moves the rotation point to the center of the cube
gui.creaturestudio.paint.stretch_tip: The whole texture covers each face of the cube instead of repeating. Great for eyes and mouths.
gui.creaturestudio.paint.glow_tip: The part is drawn at full brightness even in the dark.
gui.creaturestudio.behavior.passive.desc: Never attacks. Runs away when hit.
gui.creaturestudio.behavior.neutral.desc: Minds its own business, but fights back when attacked.
gui.creaturestudio.behavior.hostile.desc: Chases and attacks the players it sees.
gui.creaturestudio.ai.sound_tooltip: Use the sounds of a Minecraft mob
gui.creaturestudio.spawn.natural_tip: When off, the creature only appears from its egg or with "Summon".
gui.creaturestudio.egg.preview: This is how the egg will look
gui.creaturestudio.library.new_tooltip: Create a new creature starting from a template
gui.creaturestudio.library.import_toolti: Load a creature from a .json file
gui.creaturestudio.library.edit_tooltip: Open the editor (also double click or Enter)
gui.creaturestudio.library.duplicate_too: Makes a copy to create a variant
gui.creaturestudio.library.egg_tooltip: Gives you an egg to place the creature. In survival it costs 1 chicken egg.
gui.creaturestudio.library.summon_toolti: Spawns the creature next to you (creative or operator only).
gui.creaturestudio.library.export_toolti: Saves the creature as a .json file to share it
gui.creaturestudio.editor.preview.mouse_: Use the mouse to move, stretch and paint parts directly in the 3D view (M key)
gui.creaturestudio.tool.move.help: Drag the part or its X/Y/Z arrows to move it · Shift: fine step · Click the background: rotate the view · Right drag: pan
gui.creaturestudio.tool.resize.help: Drag the little squares on the faces to grow or shrink the part · Shift: fine step · Click the background: rotate the view
gui.creaturestudio.tool.brush.help: Click and drag on the model to paint pixel by pixel · -/+: brush size · Click the background: rotate the view
gui.creaturestudio.tool.eraser.help: Drag over the model to erase paint (the texture underneath shows again)
gui.creaturestudio.tool.picker.help: Click the model to copy that color to the brush
gui.creaturestudio.tool.color_tip: Brush color: change it in the Paint tab
gui.creaturestudio.tool.shape_off: Tip: turn on "Mouse" to move and stretch the part by dragging it in the 3D view.
gui.creaturestudio.vanilla.title: Minecraft models (%s)
gui.creaturestudio.vanilla.hint: Every entity in the game. Hover to see them and click to load their shape and texture; then edit them as you like. Your stats and behavior stay the same.
gui.creaturestudio.vanilla.failed: That model could not be loaded.
gui.creaturestudio.paint.mouse_off: Turn on the brush and paint directly on the model in the 3D view.
gui.creaturestudio.paint.clear_part_tip: Removes the hand painting of this part
gui.creaturestudio.paint.clear_all_tip: Removes the hand painting of every part (Ctrl+Z undoes it)
gui.creaturestudio.paint.hint: You can paint on any part without selecting it first. Paint shows on top of the base color and texture; the eraser removes it. Keys: B brush, E eraser, I picker, M mouse.
gui.creaturestudio.paint.too_much: This creature has too much paint: erase some before painting another part.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.none.desc: The part does not move by itself (but still follows its parent).
gui.creaturestudio.anim.head: Head
gui.creaturestudio.anim.head.desc: Looks where the creature looks: up/down and sideways.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.leg_a.desc: Swings back and forth while walking. Use A on one leg and B on the other.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.leg_b.desc: Like leg A but on the opposite step.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.arm_a.desc: Swings while walking and punches forward when attacking.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.arm_b.desc: Like arm A but on the opposite step.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.side_leg_a.desc: For legs pointing sideways (spiders, insects): sweeps forward and back.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.side_leg_b.desc: Like A but on the opposite step. Alternate them along the body.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.wing_a.desc: Flaps up and down; very fast while flying. For the wing on the left (+X) side.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.wing_b.desc: Mirrored version of the other wing. "Mirror X" assigns it automatically.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.tail.desc: Wags sideways. On chains of parts it creates a wavy motion.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.bob.desc: Moves gently up and down, like breathing or a bouncing slime.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.jaw.desc: Opens a little now and then and fully when attacking. Put the pivot at the hinge.
gui.creaturestudio.anim.spin.desc: Spins non-stop around its vertical axis (propellers, rings, crystals...).
gui.creaturestudio.anim.sway.desc: Leans from side to side while walking, great for bodies.
